title: Mosaic UI Access Guide
text:
Most people just need read access, which is the `mosaic-ui-read-only` role. To request it:

1. Send an email to **helpdesk@meridian.example** with the subject line "Mosaic UI Access Request."
2. Include your manager's name and a short reason for the request (e.g. "new hire, need to look up account records").
3. The helpdesk forwards your request to the **IT Manager**, who approves standard read-only requests.
4. Once approved, IT will set up your access and email you a confirmation.

Turnaround is usually about a week, depending on how backed up the helpdesk queue is. If you haven't heard back after 10 business days, reply to your original email and CC your manager.

text:
All API consumers connected to Orion Gateway are subject to the following limits:

| Metric | Standard | Burst (30s window) |
|---|---|---|

| Concurrent connections | 100 per service | N/A |
| Request payload size | 10 MB | N/A |

These limits apply to all services equally and are enforced at the gateway level.

title: Orion Gateway Rate Limit Policy
text:
If your service exceeds its rate limit:

1. The gateway returns HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) for all subsequent requests
2. Requests are rejected immediately; no queueing or backoff is performed
3. Standard exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, 16s...) is recommended for client implementations

Break glass access should only be used when:

- A security incident requires immediate remediation (malware, data breach, account compromise)
- An outage is affecting production and normal access channels are blocked
- Authorized approvers are unreachable and immediate action is required

title: Glossary of Platform & Access Terms
text:
**API Key** — A secret token used by services to authenticate with Orion Gateway or other APIs. Must be stored in Vault, never hardcoded.

**Break Glass Access** — Emergency access mechanism that temporarily grants elevated privileges when normal access routes are unavailable (e.g., during a security incident).

**Cross-Account Role** — An IAM role in one AWS account that trusts another account, allowing users to assume it without sharing credentials.

**Namespace** — An isolated collection of secrets within Vault, scoped to a team or service (e.g., `meridian/platform-eng/secrets`).

**RBAC** — Role-Based Access Control. A system where permissions are assigned to named roles, and users are assigned to roles. See role matrix pages for role definitions.

**ServiceNow Access Catalog** — Meridian's central system for requesting access to internal tools and services. Replaces the Old Intranet Portal.

**Provisioning** — The automated process of granting access to a user after approval.

**Revocation** — The process of removing a user's access to a system or service.
